Fix 4 HIGH review findings from R-379 (the just-completed code review — see .workflow/state/last-review.json). All four are on origin/master right now and need fixing before any user enables `scheduledMode.enabled: true`.

**F1 (security, HIGH)**: `.github/workflows/wogi-scheduled.yml:151` — the `per-pr-review` job uses `pull_request` trigger and checks out `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` (the fork's HEAD) WHILE setting `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in env (line 160). A fork-PR contributor can edit `scripts/flow-scheduled-runner.js` in their PR and exfiltrate the key. Fix: add `if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository` to the per-pr-review job so it only runs on PRs from the same repo (not forks). Optionally also add a comment explaining the trade-off vs. `pull_request_target`. Verify by reading the resulting YAML — no fork code path may touch the secret.

**F2 (correctness, HIGH)**: `scripts/flow-scheduled-runner.js:22` + `.claude/docs/scheduled-mode.md:117` — both claim "Operates in a temp worktree created via scripts/flow-worktree.js", but `flow-worktree.js` is never imported. Fix: actually implement the temp-worktree isolation. Import `createWorktree`/`runInWorktree`/`cleanupStaleWorktrees` from `scripts/flow-worktree.js`. Wrap each job's execution inside `runInWorktree({ taskId: \`scheduled-${jobName}-${timestamp}\` }, async (worktreePath) => { ... })`. Ensure cleanup on both success and crash paths. **CRITICAL**: failure to create the worktree must NOT silently fall back — must hard-error so the invariant holds. Add a test that mocks `runInWorktree` and asserts the runner aborts when it throws.

**F3 (correctness, HIGH)**: `scripts/flow-scheduled-runner.js:376` — `runPerPrReview()` builds `const prompt = \`ultrareview ${prNumber}\`` and sends to `claude -p`. That's a literal text string — NOT the `claude ultrareview <PR>` subcommand (Claude Code 2.1.120+) NOR the `/ultrareview <PR>` slash command. Fix: switch to the slash-command form for consistency with how `/wogi-audit` is invoked at line 342: `const prompt = \`/ultrareview ${prNumber}\`;`. Add a test asserting the prompt string starts with `/ultrareview ` (with the leading slash).

**F4 (correctness, HIGH)**: `scripts/flow-scheduled-runner.js:497` (`estimatedTokens: 0` in ctx init) + `lib/scheduled-mode.js:240` (`enforceTokenBudget` consumer). Because `estimatedTokens` is hardcoded `0`, `recordUsage(jobName, 0)` always records zero and the daily token budget cap is a permanent no-op. Fix: import `DEFAULT_TOKENS_PER_INVOCATION` from `lib/scheduled-mode.js` (already exported there, currently unused by the runner) and populate `ctx.estimatedTokens = DEFAULT_TOKENS_PER_INVOCATION[jobName] ?? 0` (using `??` per naming-conventions.md since 0 is a valid value). Also fix the `||` at line 330 → `??`. Add a test that exercises `enforceTokenBudget` rejecting a job when the configured `dailyTokenBudget` is exceeded.
